summary: BC Cancer's identity since November 2017, shared with the BC Cancer Foundation (its fundraising charity, not a government body), as vector artwork: three official SVGs unchanged and five sets of paths exported from official PDFs (supplied package; see package-README.md, source-manifest.json and provenance/). The October 2018 BC Cancer branding guideline cited by the wayfinding standards was not found; logo requests go to comms@bccancer.bc.ca.

assets.label: BC Cancer — with the PHSA line
assets.sourceLocator: New Surrey Hospital & BC Cancer Centre, Appendix 1R Wayfinding Standards & Requirements (dated 12 January 2022), PDF page 18
assets.dateNote: The source’s year, not an adoption date.
assets.notes: BC / CAN / CER stacked in heavy geometric capitals — turquoise, with CAN in purple and a dot in the A — over “Provincial Health Services Authority”: BC Cancer’s logo since November 2017. The standards give its colours as Pantone 3115 C and 2583 C.
assets.fidelityNote: The publication’s own vector paths, exported from the PDF and isolated without changing their data, transforms or fills; the lettering was already outlined. Colours are the publication’s RGB rendering.
